name: Give developers a complete component brief
why: Turns source files into a brief with variants, states, accessible behaviour and design tokens, the input the component build skill needs.

name: Design handoff completeness assistant
why: Finds the states and variants a design forgot before any code is written, matching the every-state rule.

name: Static HTML landing page builder
why: Turns checked copy and layout into plain HTML and CSS with accessible forms and hosting steps, like the one-file landing page prompt.

name: Landing page design planner
why: Gives three on-brand design directions and a build brief to code from.

name: Quarterly accessibility keeper
why: Ranks accessibility gaps each quarter and checks last quarter's fixes, a longer-running version of the accessibility fix pass.

name: Monthly design system keeper
why: Finds drift from design rules and checks contrast in the code each month, so components stay consistent.

name: Website quality keeper
why: Weekly check of what got slower or harder to find, feeding the monthly speed and accessibility workflow.

name: Find what is slow, fix it and show the numbers
why: Ranks the cause of slowness, fixes it and shows before-and-after timings in a pull request, the same evidence habit as the page speed skill.

name: Fix a bug with proof and a clear pull request
why: Proves a rendering or state bug before fixing it and hands over a reviewable pull request.

name: Pull request reviewer
why: A second review of front-end pull requests before the client merges them.

name: Make a code change in small tested steps with AI
why: Splits a UI change into small tested steps with rules for an AI coding helper, useful for larger refactors.
